text:
tara.sales: ZenithTrust wants an evidence bundle for procurement (SOC2 excerpt, ISO page, pen-test attestation) and asked if they can run an authenticated scan during the 7-day POC. Need quick yes/no + what we can share.
leo.se: We can share SOC2 Type II cover/excerpt, ISO 27001 certificate page + scope statement, and a signed pen-test attestation with a 1-page executive summary. No raw reports or audit working papers.
miguel.security: Authenticated scans allowed only on isolated staging or dedicated endpoints. Requirements: approved test plan, source IP allowlist, test window, signed NDA addendum, no destructive actions, rate limits. We supervise tests for an SOW.
tara.sales: They prefer SFTP upload. Ops can do presigned S3 but procurement insists on SFTP.
ops-bot: I can provide SFTP dropbox or presigned S3. Need recipient emails and legal entity for signed attestation.
leo.se: Copy/paste checklist for procurement portal:
``
- SOC 2 Type II: cover/excerpt PDF (no audit working papers)
- ISO 27001: certificate page + scope statement
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter + 1-page exec summary (no raw reports)
- High-level network diagram (redacted)
- KMS & encryption controls summary
- Pre-scan requirements: test plan, source IPs, test window, scope (staging/dedicated), signed NDA addendum
- Delivery: SFTP or presigned S3 (time-limited)
- Contact for SOW/supervised-test quote
```
leo.se: Pricing blurb: "Standard enterprise POC includes the basic evidence pack. Supervised authenticated scans, legal redaction, or extended audits are billable via SOW; indicative small engagements start at $5k."
tara.sales: ZenithTrust legal name is "ZenithTrust Holdings, Inc." I will ask for IPs and preferred windows and send checklist.
